newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela military prisoners stage rooftop protest.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela military prisoners stage rooftop protest.

text.p: About 60 prisoners at a Venezuelan military jail staged a rooftop protest on Tuesday to demand more time out of their cells and extra family visits, local radio reported.

The inmates at the prison in Ramo Verde, about 20 miles (30 km) west of Caracas, made signs to indicate that they were holding two security officials hostage, Radio Caracas said. This report could not be confirmed immediately.
There were no reports of injuries.
Radio and television reports said the demonstration started early Tuesday morning when inmates set fire to mattresses.
Officials and a district attorney were talking with the prisoners to restore calm.
